It totals 232,000 square feet with planned expansion to 462,000 square feet. The page states 24 MW provisioned in an N plus 2 scheme with 12 MW on site and an on site substation capable of supporting 50 MW total; because the on site current figure (12 MW) and the provisioned target (24 MW) are both mentioned without a single unambiguous current operating critical IT load number, this is recorded as a capacity note rather than critical_it_mw. High density cabinets of 10kW plus are supported, with access to 12 network providers.

reading: fifteenfortyseven Critical Systems Realty, known as 1547, is a data center developer, operator, and owner headquartered in Matawan, New Jersey, led by CEO and Managing Director J. Todd Raymond. The company manages more than 1.1 million square feet of data center space across North America through a partnership structure with Harrison Street, an investment management firm focused on alternative real assets. Harrison Street acquired a four-facility portfolio in November 2021 that 1547 operates day to day. That portfolio included the Orangeburg, New York facility recorded in this registry, branded ORNY1, a purpose-built colocation site about 18 miles from New York City marketed around ultra-low latency connectivity for financial and enterprise customers, alongside a Chicago, Illinois facility at 725 Wells Street in the South Loop plus an adjacent Midway Technology Center with expansion capacity, and a fully leased Cheyenne, Wyoming facility occupied by a national IT services firm. The combined November 2021 portfolio totaled more than 560,000 square feet, and 1547 has continued to expand the Orangeburg facility's data hall capacity in subsequent years according to company announcements. As of the research date, 1547 operates nine active locations, having previously sold properties in Pennsylvania and Chicago, reflecting an active buy, operate, and periodically divest strategy typical of institutionally backed data center real estate platforms.

sources.title: 1547 Realty - Harrison Street and fifteenfortyseven Critical Systems Realty Acquire Portfolio of Four Data Centers
